div.div: While the diagnostic is in progress, only the DONE interrupt is enabled on the CRCSCAN interrupt vector. An interrupt in this state means the error injection scan has finished. Using the diagnostic API, clear the DONE flag so the ISR can return and signal the diagnostic function to resume checking and reporting the result to the diagnostic initiator. Since the DONE flag is cleared, the resulting error status from the intentional error injection is not reported to the Error Handler below.
